decision: benchmark the real MissionCoordinator persistence-failure path before replacing exact snapshot rollback

reviews.correctness: Measure failed enqueue and failed claim through MissionCoordinator and assert exact rollback plus fail-closed poisoning; primitive snapshot timing alone is insufficient.
reviews.robustness: Use a deterministic failing store and verify no ghost mission, idempotency entry, worker ownership, lease token, or attempt increment survives failure.
reviews.latency_resources_regression: Keep exact snapshot rollback until measured end-to-end p95 proves it too expensive. This adds benchmark-only CPU/memory cost and no runtime network or Qubes dependency.

alternatives.rejected: does not include coordinator serialization, mutation bookkeeping, persistence failure handling, or poisoning
larger correctness and regression surface without evidence that exact rollback misses the target budget

qa: Measure failed enqueue and failed claim at 10/100/1000 missions; verify exact state rollback and fail-closed behavior; compare p95 against explicit lab budgets.
lesson: Optimize rollback representation only after the full failure path, not an isolated clone primitive, demonstrates a material bottleneck.
